remarks: Welcome to this beautiful ranch-style first-floor condo in Norwalk! Offering 1,196 square feet of comfortable living space, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom unit is move-in ready. The open floor plan is highlighted by stunning Brazilian cherry hardwood floors, creating an elegant and inviting atmosphere. The spacious living area seamlessly flows into the dining space, which features a convenient dry bar-perfect for entertaining. Enjoy easy access to the outdoors with sliders leading to a private rear deck, providing a great spot to relax. Both bedrooms are generously sized, offering ample closet space. The unit is also equipped with in-unit laundry for your convenience. Located in a well-maintained complex with an inground pool, this condo offers a fantastic lifestyle with plenty of parking
